description: Multi-tenant (Sec. IV-C2, Fig. 6; claim multi-tenant-gain): four concurrent clients (5Q/1L, 5Q/2L, 7Q/1L, 7Q/2L, one epoch each at the paper's circuit counts) on four workers of 5, 10, 15 and 20 qubits with one simulation slot each; circuits share a worker within its qubits; co-Manager lowest-CPU rule (Algorithm 2).
